purpose: Combine the public-transfer proxy gate and the post-ID341 joint-distribution warning lens. A candidate must pass both gates before it can be called a Public 0.58 review candidate.

gate_definition.transfer_gate_pass: unscored candidate with artifact_exists=true, transfer_tier `would_pass_numeric_gate_review_needed`, and proxy_public_risk <= public_058_proxy_gate
gate_definition.joint_gate_pass: unscored candidate with joint tier in low/watch and warning_count <= 1

decision.next_action: No local candidate should be submitted unless it passes this combined gate and then receives a separate artifact-contract/manual approval review. If no row passes, stop same-family local recombination and move to the explicit-approved Kaggle upstream rebuild.
